questions.question: Language skills enable users to express and communicate thought in which manner?
questions.explanation: Language skills help users express thoughts comprehensibly and intelligibly.

questions.question: The four language skills are listening, speaking, reading and which other?
questions.explanation: Writing completes the four language skills.

questions.question: Listening and speaking skills are mostly described as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Listening and speaking are mostly acquired.

questions.question: Reading and writing skills are described as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Reading and writing are learnt.

questions.question: Listening and reading are classified as which type of skills?
questions.explanation: Listening and reading are passive or receptive skills.

questions.question: Speaking and writing are classified as which type of skills?
questions.explanation: Speaking and writing are active or productive skills.

questions.question: Listening skill is ranked as which language skill?
questions.explanation: Listening is the first and foremost language skill.

questions.question: Listening skill is defined as which kind of process?
questions.explanation: Listening is a psychological and active process.

questions.question: Hearing is best described as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Hearing is passive perception of sounds through the ears.

questions.question: Three key elements involved in listening are sender, message and which other?
questions.explanation: Listening involves a sender, a message and a receiver.

questions.question: Which component is the physical response caused by sound wave?
questions.explanation: Hearing is the physical response caused by sound wave.

questions.question: Understanding in listening requires listeners to analyse which of the following?
questions.explanation: Understanding involves analysing symbols heard or seen.

questions.question: Remembering and interpreting require listeners to express ideas about which of the following?
questions.explanation: Listeners express ideas about the intended meaning.

questions.question: Evaluating in listening requires listeners to weigh evidence and sort fact from which other item?
questions.explanation: Evaluating involves sorting fact from opinion.

questions.question: Responding in listening is completed through which means?
questions.explanation: Responding uses verbal and non-verbal feedback.

questions.question: The two types of listening are active listening and which other?
questions.explanation: Listening is classified as active or passive.

questions.question: An active listener does which of the following?
questions.explanation: An active listener paraphrases and reflects the message back.

questions.question: Which item is listed as a factor of poor listening habit?
questions.explanation: Fatigue is one factor of poor listening habit.

questions.question: Emotional problems are classified as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Emotional problems are a factor of poor listening habit.

questions.question: A listener should pay adequate attention to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Listeners should focus on the message, not the speaker's style.

questions.question: Listening to lectures requires using what to meet up?
questions.explanation: Abbreviations and symbols help students meet up during lectures.

questions.question: During lectures, students should put down main points and which other item?
questions.explanation: Students record main points and supporting details.

questions.question: Speaking skill deals with selecting, organising and producing which of the following?
questions.explanation: Speaking skill involves producing language sounds.

questions.question: Ogayi and Chima in 2005 linked good vocabulary to knowledge of which system?
questions.explanation: They linked vocabulary to knowledge of how the sound system operates.

questions.question: Which item is a component of speaking skill?
questions.explanation: Stress patterns are a component of speaking skill.

questions.question: The most important concern of speaking skill is mastery of sounds, stress and which other feature?
questions.explanation: Sounds, stress and intonation patterns must be mastered.

questions.question: Reading skill deals with perceiving and understanding which of the following?
questions.explanation: Reading skill involves perceiving and understanding writing symbols.

questions.question: In reading, the writer is regarded as the encoder and the reader as which of the following?
questions.explanation: The writer encodes while the reader decodes.

questions.question: Reading without comprehension is described as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Reading without comprehension is no reading.

questions.question: Skimming is used to get which of the following?
questions.explanation: Skimming helps readers get the overall message.

questions.question: Silent reading is best described as reading without which feature?
questions.explanation: Silent reading is reading without audible noise.

questions.question: Reading aloud is particularly required during which activity?
questions.explanation: Reading aloud is required during speech presentation.

questions.question: Intensive reading is also known as which type of reading?
questions.explanation: Intensive reading is slow-careful reading for detailed information.

questions.question: Extensive reading is also regarded as which type of reading?
questions.explanation: Extensive reading is free reading for general knowledge.

questions.question: Critical reading is done to reach what is good or which other quality?
questions.explanation: Critical reading evaluates what is good or bad in a passage.

questions.question: Vocalisation is the habit of doing which of the following?
questions.explanation: Vocalisation is pronouncing each word aloud as you read.

questions.question: Counting words before reading is bad because it does which of the following?
questions.explanation: Counting words slows the speed of reading.

questions.question: Finger pointing is bad because the finger cannot move as fast as which organ?
questions.explanation: The finger cannot move as fast as the eyes.

questions.question: Head movement during reading is bad because it reduces which of the following?
questions.explanation: Moving the head side to side reduces concentration.

questions.question: Daydreaming during reading involves thinking of which kind of things?
questions.explanation: Daydreaming involves thinking of irrelevant things.

questions.question: Memorisation is bad because it risks inability to recall under which condition?
questions.explanation: Memorisation risks inability to recall because of psychological tension.

questions.question: Writing skill is classified by some authorities as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Writing is classified as the most complex of all skills.

questions.question: Writing skill is defined as expressing ideas through which medium?
questions.explanation: Writing skill is the act of expressing ideas through written words.

questions.question: Ogayi in 2005 defined writing skill as the skilful use of which items?
questions.explanation: Ogayi defined writing skill as the skilful use of language symbols.

questions.question: A writer is advised to reread a document before doing which of the following?
questions.explanation: A writer should reread the document before final submission.

questions.question: Reading extensively helps improve writing by providing new vocabularies and which other item?
questions.explanation: Reading exposes writers to new vocabularies and good presentations with different styles.

questions.question: Writing with audience in mind helps a writer produce which of the following?
questions.explanation: Writing with the audience in mind helps produce a good composition.

questions.question: Knowledge of written conventions includes spelling and which other item?
questions.explanation: Written conventions include spelling and punctuation marks.

questions.question: Unity and cohesion require every element to support which of the following?
questions.explanation: Unity and cohesion require every element to support one central idea.

questions.question: The assignment asks students to discuss why listening and speaking are classified as which type of skills?
questions.explanation: The assignment asks about listening and speaking as passive or receptive skills.
